name: Animation review compares original poses and invalidates intentional marks after drawing
description: Using visible controls on a fresh 32 by 32 project, create two original drawn frames, review their changes at native pixel zoom, mark an interval intentional, undo and redo that mark, then draw on the reviewed artwork and verify a rescan requires a new judgment. Also verify the named region controls and their reversible metadata. No upload, external account or development-only application handles are needed.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /studio. Wait for the editor to finish loading. Use Start a New Blank Drawing if artwork already exists, confirming only if requested. Verify the size control shows 32×32 and the timeline has one frame.
Open the Palette inspector tab and choose a dark or saturated visible color swatch. Select Pen in the left rail, then draw a small short stroke near the center of the main canvas.
Click + Frame in the bottom timeline to add a blank second frame, then draw a different short stroke near the center of its main canvas. Do not use Import or file dialogs.
Open the PixiTools inspector tab. If a tool task is already open, use Choose another task. Choose Review animation, then click Create clip from all frames.
Keep Align whole-sprite motion checked and Compare last frame to first unchecked. Click Scan animation and wait for the Frame interval selector and review metrics to appear.

Verify the Frame interval is Frame 1 → 2, with outline and silhouette change counts, color/alpha change counts and connected-cluster counts. Scroll the inspector to verify separate Before: frame 1, Aligned: frame 2 and Changed pixels canvases are stacked beneath the metrics and include a red/blue/purple change legend. Both original timeline frames still exist.
Set Animation comparison zoom to 1× native pixels. Inspect the three comparison canvases without changing the drawing.
Verify each comparison canvas is displayed at its 32 by 32 native pixel dimensions rather than stretched to fill the inspector. Verify the surrounding comparison panes fit within the inspector width.
Click Mark this change intentional. Click Undo last action in the top header, then click Redo last action.

Verify the mark initially changes the button to Reopen this interval and shows Marked intentional for these exact frames and settings. Undo returns Mark this change intentional; redo restores Reopen this interval. The review imagery remains present.
Select Pen and draw an additional visible stroke on the current reviewed frame's main canvas.
Verify the old review report disappears and Artwork or review regions changed. Scan again. is shown in the inspector.
Click Scan animation again and wait for the updated report.
Verify the updated interval offers Mark this change intentional, rather than treating the previous saved mark as approval of the changed artwork.

Choose the Box Selection tool from the left rail and drag a small rectangular selection inside the main canvas. In the review inspector expand Regions and protection, name the region Eye highlight, leave Purpose set to Protect during Pixel Cleanup, and click Save selected region.

Verify Regions and protection shows one region, with Eye highlight: protect and its canvas coordinates/dimensions. Verify the panel explicitly explains protection applies to Scan Artwork / Apply Cleanup while this clip is selected.
Click Undo last action then Redo last action in the header.
Verify undo removes Eye highlight from the region list, and redo restores the named protected region, while both animation frames remain available.
